players.product: Metal soft-magnetic materials and chip inductors (including modular inductors for vertical power delivery) that supply front-end power to GPU, CPU, ASIC and FPGA chips in AI servers

quarterly_data.quarter: POCO Holding results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Director, vice president and board secretary Ruan Jialin (2025 annual and Q1 2026 results briefing): market demand for both chip inductors and metal powder cores grew clearly in Q1 2026 and the company expects the trend to hold for the full year, with AI-related areas performing even more strongly; the company is optimistic. He said 2025 grew only slightly because several chip-inductor projects' end products had not started mass production in the first half, but inductor sales began ramping clearly in the fourth quarter and have continued since; as new chip-inductor capacity starts up, chip inductors' share of revenue and profit will rise further.

quarterly_data.quarter: POCO Holding results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Board secretary Ruan Jialin (results briefing): with energy security pushing investment in PV, energy storage, new-energy vehicles and power infrastructure, market demand for metal powder cores has grown significantly, especially from the second quarter, and the company is stepping up production to meet it; chairman Du Jianghua expects high capacity utilisation this year based on current orders, and Ruan said utilisation is currently close to full.

quarterly_data.quarter: POCO Holding results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Board secretary Ruan Jialin (results briefing): infrastructure of phase 1 of the new high-end integrated molded inductor project in Huidong County is complete and, once acceptance procedures are done, it is expected to be put into production around mid-year; the Thailand plant is progressing well and is expected to start production mid-year if procedures go as planned; phase 2 of the inductor project will initially be built with the company's own funds, with land acquisition and construction start expected this year, subject to government procedures.

quarterly_data.quarter: POCO Holding results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO You Xin (results briefing): depreciation from new capacity will put slight short-term pressure on gross margin while utilisation ramps; as capacity fills and scale effects and product mix improve, overall gross margin should improve steadily. Chairman Du Jianghua said metal powder core sales into inverters are good and so far unaffected by EU restrictions on Chinese inverters, with the policy's effect still to be seen.

quarterly_data.quarter: POCO Holding results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Board secretary Ruan Jialin (results briefing): the chip inductors now in mass production mainly serve GPU, ASIC and other cloud-computing uses and are customised products; the share of standard products will rise as its consumer-electronics products and capacity are completed. Its DDR memory inductors have completed development and validation and are in market promotion; its optical-module inductors have won mass-production orders; it has developed modular vertical power-delivery technology; and its joint venture with Junwei Electronics (pinyin), meant to widen chip-inductor sales, is going through pre-approvals including ODI (outbound direct investment), progressing smoothly.

players.product: Chip inductors (incl. modular inductors for vertical power delivery) on in-house metal soft-magnetic powder for GPU / ASIC / CPU power conversion
